people.name: Berea
people.line: City in Macedonia where Paul preached; home of Sopater.

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

people.name: Thessalonica
people.line: Macedonian city, site of an early Christian church

translations.web: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.
translations.bsb: But when the Jews from Thessalonica learned that Paul was also proclaiming the word of God in Berea, they went there themselves to incite and agitate the crowds.
translations.kjv: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.
translations.asv: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed of Paul at Beroea also, they came thither likewise, stirring up and troubling the multitudes.
